The atom/atom GitHub repository was archived on March 3, 2023, making it read-only. The website fixture confirms discontinuation. All independent categories—development, maintenance, infrastructure, and stewardship—show cessation of meaningful human activity, with a credible and official discontinuation announcement from GitHub.
value.policy_text: STRICT v1: Declare ABANDONED only if multiple independent categories (development, maintenance, infrastructure, stewardship) all lack meaningful human activity and there is no credible continuation announcement. Any single positive stewardship signal should prevent ABANDONED.
value.summary: Atom was officially sunset by GitHub on December 15, 2022. The repository was archived by the owner on March 3, 2023, and is now read-only. No further development, maintenance, or stewardship is occurring. GitHub explicitly announced the end of all support, security updates, and package management.
